_about: 1,4-Butanediol (1) + gamma-Butyrolactone (2): isothermal total pressures at 383.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1,4-butanediol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.
